title: Base height regulations
previewText: Except for zoning lots located south of West 31st Street and east of Avenue of the Americas, the maximum base height of a street wall may vary between the applicable maximum set forth in the underlying regulations, inclusive, and the height of the street wall of adjacent building before setback, if such height is higher than the maximum base height.
